title: Recursive order bound for algebraic differential operators
statement: Let $R$ and $C$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure on $C$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let $M,N$ be $C$-modules, regarded as $R$-modules by restriction of scalars, and let $D:M\to N$ be $R$-linear. Define the predicate that $D$ has differential order at most $n\in\mathbb N$ over $C/R$ recursively: at $n=0$ it means $D(cx)=cD(x)$ for every $c\in C$ and $x\in M$; at $n+1$ it means that for every $c\in C$ the $R$-linear map $[D,c]:x\mapsto D(cx)-cD(x)$ has differential order at most $n$.
